title: Please buy a different mister!
text: Please buy a different mister!. The cons: It's not easy to use. Took me several tries to get it to spray at all. Pressing the button is not easy - hurts the finger.  And then the outside gets really sticky! (and it gets oily underneath - leaves a little puddle on the counter.  The pros: I honestly can't think of any. Not a one.  I just ordered a different brand that a friend swears by. This is going in the garbage.

UNIQUE FILTER: keeps the sprayer clear and allows you to create your own flavors with herbs and spices
